criteria.name: vuln_recall
criteria.description: Mean over the cases that list it of the share of their vulnerable pinned packages that the known_vulnerabilities examination reports in the same file within 2 lines, citing an advisory that OSV returned for that package version.

criteria.name: no_fabricated_advisories
criteria.description: Mean over the cases that list it of 1 when every advisory ID a finding cites is an ID or an alias that the recorded OSV responses hold, otherwise 0.

criteria.name: hygiene_recall
criteria.description: Mean over the cases that list it of the share of their seeded hygiene issues that the dependency_hygiene examination reports in the same file within 2 lines.

criteria.name: clean_precision
criteria.description: Mean over the cases that list it of 1 when the case gets no critical or high finding in any step, and where OSV lookups are meant to fail its limitations name every such package and its known_vulnerabilities step reports no finding, otherwise 0.
